Subject: Joint GTM & integration onboarding: Datadog + Grafana observability adapters

Hi Lisa & Mike —

Thanks for taking time to explore a joint approach for observability integrations. Quick context from our side: Redwood has a new set of adapters that translate our serving runtime telemetry into OTLP -> Datadog and native Grafana dashboards. We think there is a strong co-sell/opportunity to position Redwood as the low-latency inference layer that feeds telemetry into Datadog for SLOs and Grafana for cross-team dashboards.

Goals for this thread: align on a partner onboarding checklist (tech + go-to-market), confirm required artifacts for marketplace listings, and pick a timeline for a combined technical + GTM kickoff.

Initial asks:
- Can Datadog confirm the marketplace listing timeline and partner materials needed?
- Can Grafana share the marketplace submission checklist and branding guidelines?
- Marcus: please capture the minimum technical requirements and sample metrics/traces we need to demonstrate.

I attached a draft co-sell playbook and a technical checklist (first pass). Links: HubSpot deal (shared below), calendly for scheduling.

Proposed kickoff: Wed 11/11 10:00–11:00 PT — if that works, I’ll lock it.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

Vanessa —

Appreciate the intro and the materials. High level: Datadog is interested. A few quick answers and questions from our side:

- Marketplace & partner materials: we have a Partner Portal checklist (I’ll share the PDF after this). Typical asks: integration overview, security summary, SAAS listing manifest, and sample dashboards/screenshots.
- Technical: OTLP is fine — we can ingest OTLP metrics/traces/logs via the Datadog OTLP intake. For demos, we prefer a short replayable trace + sample metrics tagged with service.name and model.version.
- Compliance: our partners typically include a short note about data retention and PII handling in the listing. Can your security team provide the retention policy and SOC2 report excerpts?

I’m copying partners@datadoghq.com for onboarding coordination. For kickoff: Wed 11/11 10:00 PT works for us. Please include an agenda with tech vs GTM split.

Quick ask for Marcus: can you confirm the OTLP export endpoint and an example proto/JSON payload you’ll use so we can pre-wire ingestion rules?

Thanks — Lisa

> Vanessa —
> 
> Appreciate the intro and the materials. High level: Datadog is interested. A few quick answers and questions from our side:
> 
> - Marketplace & partner materials: we have a Partner Portal checklist (I’ll share the PDF after this). Typical asks: integration overview, security summary, SAAS listing manifest, and sample dashboards/screenshots.
> - Technical: OTLP is fine — we can ingest OTLP metrics/traces/logs via the Datadog OTLP intake. For demos, we prefer a short replayable trace + sample metrics tagged with service.name and model.version.
> - Compliance: our partners typically include a short note about data retention and PII handling in the listing. Can your security team provide the retention policy and SOC2 report excerpts?

Thanks for the clarity. Quick technical notes from Redwood (answers inline):

- OTLP endpoint: we will export via gRPC/HTTP OTLP to a configurable endpoint. For the demo environment we will expose a dedicated Datadog OTLP endpoint at https://otlp-demo.datadoghq.com/v1/otlp (we will hand off credentials via secure share).
- Payload examples: attaching a small JSON sample in the shared Drive. Metric naming convention we will use: redwood.inference.tokens, redwood.inference.latency_ms, redwood.inference.kv_cache.hit_rate. Traces: span attributes include model.name, model.version, request.id.
- Retention/PII: Redwood stores raw telemetry for 30 days in hosted mode (configurable for Dedicated). We do not persist raw prompt text in telemetry by default; prompts are redacted in telemetry exports. I’ll loop in Security for SOC2 excerpts after the kickoff.
- Demo data: we will provide replayable synthetic traces (5–10 requests) and a small sample metrics stream.

Action items for Wed kickoff (proposed):
1) Tech sync (Marcus, Camila, Lisa + Datadog infra): validate OTLP wiring, ingestion rules, sample dashboards.
2) GTM sync (Vanessa + partner marketing): logos, co-branded one-pager, webinar plan.
3) Marketplace intake: align required assets and sign-off owners.

Attaching: integration-checklist-otlp-traces-metrics.xlsx (first pass).

— Marcus Lin
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime Integrations
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Hi team —

Grafana is excited to collaborate. A few notes from the marketplace & dashboards side:

- Marketplace submission: we require a short technical overview, a deployment guide (how to wire OTLP/Prometheus -> Grafana Cloud), and screenshots of dashboards/alerting. Typical time to publish is ~2–3 weeks after intake if materials are complete.
- Dashboards: we recommend a starter dashboard focused on inference health (latency p50/p95, token throughput, error rate) and a model-performance dashboard (quality metrics if available). We can provide a template we’ve used with other inference vendors.
- Co-marketing: we have a partner webinar program. If you’re interested, next quarter’s slot opens early December. We’ll need a proposed title, 2–3 bullet takeaways, and presenter names.

Proposal: co-host a short technical webinar (30–40 min) + produce a joint one-pager for marketplace and PR. For the webinar, possible dates: Tue 12/7 or Thu 12/9 (US times).

Looping in marketplace@grafana.com for intake logistics. For branding assets, please send a logos-and-bio-pack.zip (we can accept SVG/PNG + short speaker bios).

— Mike Ortega
